title: ESP32 Drone Ecosystem is Exploding in May 2026
context: 5 new ESP32 drone projects discovered on GitHub with active development in May 2026. Previously, the ecosystem was sparse.
what_was_found: New projects: sergiovirahonda/cortex (132 stars, DShot600+LiDAR), songge8/CF-Drone (106 stars, web remote), ElektroJonas/DIY-Quadcopter (57 stars, academic PID+Kalman), cifertech/ESP32-Drone (22 stars, browser UI), ace-cooper/AceMicroFlyer (21 stars, ESP32-C3). Emerging standard: dual-core FreeRTOS + WiFi/WebSocket at 20Hz. Web-based ground stations are winning.
gap_identified: No ESP32 autonomous waypoint navigation project exists. Avatar could be first to implement GPS waypoint navigation on ESP32.
action: Study cortex architecture (dual-core + DShot600). Evaluate CF-Drone's web remote pattern. Consider ESP-NOW vs WiFi for control link.
